egress.terms: Free and unmetered via cdn.stoatusercontent.com on Cloudflare. CDN responses specify `Cache-Control: public, max-age=2073600`, providing 24 days of edge caching.

record.tooling: Autumn file service: `POST {autumn}/attachments` with multipart `file` and `X-Bot-Token`/`X-Session-Token`. Documented at stoatchat/stoatchat `docs/docs/developers/api/uploading-files.md`. Bots are first-class; 5 bots per account.
record.chaining: 100 servers per account x 200 channels per server (from the live `/` limits object) = 20,000 channels, each with unlimited messages. Servers are capped at 100 for existing accounts / 50 for new ones.
record.limits_note: 20 MB per file; 5 attachments per message; body_limit_size 20,000,000 bytes globally. Live limits object also gives: emojis 500 KB, icons 2.5 MB, banners/backgrounds 6 MB, avatars 4 MB. Those are separate, smaller buckets.
record.reliability_note: Critically different from Discord: attachment URLs are UNSIGNED and permanent. The platform renamed Revolt->Stoat in Oct 2025 and moved the CDN (autumn.revolt.chat -> cdn.revoltusercontent.com) in May 2025 with 301s still in place; old IDs from the pre-refactor Autumn do 404.

evidence.proved: probe: GET -> features.limits.default.file_upload_size_limits.attachments = 20000000 (20 MB), server_channels = 200, servers = 100, message_attachments = 5
probe: GET -> 200 OK, Content-Length 10886, Cache-Control: public, max-age=2073600 — no ex/is/hm, no expiry
probe: POST with no auth -> 401 (upload requires a token; read does not)

free_tier.stated: 20 MB per file, no subscription: 'Custom emojis, a 20MB file upload limit and a server-specific profile picture with no subscription required.' No published total-storage cap and no paid tier that raises the file size.

egress.terms: Free and. Importantly. UNSIGNED. Autumn 301s to cdn.stoatusercontent.com and the object URL is a bare path with no expiry parameters, unlike Discord. So a stored URL stays valid and is trivially Cloudflare-cacheable.

record.tooling: Genuinely open: 'Our public API is so powerful that we use it ourselves for the official apps', API root answers live (GET https://api.revolt.chat/ -> {"stoat":"0.16.2","revolt":"0.16.2", features...}). Backend is open source (revoltchat/autumn, stoatchat/*). Self-hostable, which is both the appeal and the caveat.
record.chaining: Unlimited servers x unlimited channels with a 20 MB cap, so 1 TB needs ~52,000 uploads. With no signed URLs, the reads are the easy part; the writes are the bottleneck.
record.limits_note: 20 MB per file is fixed and low; there is no path to a bigger unit. Upload limits are server-configurable only on SELF-hosted instances ('Upload limits are controlled via the Autumn config'), so on the public instance you are stuck at 20 MB.
record.reliability_note: Smaller operator, recent rebrand to Stoat, and the public instance runs human-verification step on signup. Data longevity is a real question for a 20 TiB cold archive; treat as experimental.
